title: account triage + QBR sprint: morning velocity list
content:
Date: 2026-09-02
Sprint window: 09:00 - 12:00 (3h) — focused QBR prep + renewal triage + urgent support follow-ups

PRIORITY OBJECTIVE (90m): finalize QBR deck skeleton + pre-read + 3 action asks for renewal execs
Secondary (60m): close or move blockers on support tickets that will show in QBR incident list
Triage (30m): renewals posture quick-check for top 6 accounts

---
Morning checklist (live)
- [ ] Export last 90-day usage by model & route for Cobalt, DriftNet, Skyway (summaries: p95 latency, tokens/month, error rate)
- [ ] Snapshot cost breakdown (tokens vs infra) for Cobalt — need to show impact of batching suggestion
- [ ] Pull incident timeline for DriftNet (CS-4217) and write 3 bullet causal story + remediation status
- [ ] Draft slide: "What changed since last QBR" (3 bullets max per product)
- [ ] Confirm exec attendee list + calendar invites (email Yossi, Lina, and PO)
- [ ] Pre-read email: send to execs with 1-page summary + ask (expand Dedicated capacity or 12-mo commit)

Account quick triage (top 6)
1) Cobalt (renewal Q4) — RISK: medium-high
   - Usage: up 40% MoM, plateauing p95 latency spikes at peak windows
   - Tickets: CS-4392 (throttling on /generate at 18:00-19:00 PST) — owner: Derek H.
   - QBR ask: propose dedicated capacity pilot for peak windows; show cost delta vs hosted
   - Today action: finalize cost slide + schedule 30m pilot planning sync (Derek + infra)
2) DriftNet — RISK: high (support noise + exec concern)
   - Incident CS-4217: KV cache invalidation bug — root cause note: rollout of model variant v2.1 changed past-kv behavior
   - Mitigation: hotfix deployed to 3 clusters, monitoring green; still verifying edge cases
   - QBR ask: short-term SLA credit + roadmap item for telemetry improvements
   - Today action: write incident blurb + reach out to Eng PM for postmortem slot
3) Skyway — RISK: low-medium (on free tier, exploring embeddings)
   - Opportunity: upsell embeddings and Optimize review for quantization gains
   - Today action: draft 2-pager ROI case for embeddings pilot
4) Solstice — RISK: medium (security review in progress)
   - Need: KMS/HSM docs and audit logs sample
   - Today action: pull compliance checklist + assign to Priya
5) Meridian — RISK: low (renewal later)
   - Note: internal champions changed; add "stakeholder map" slide
6) BlueHarbor — RISK: medium (cost surprise)
   - Action: run per-route token breakdown and propose batching knob changes

Support follow-ups (tickets to close / update today)
- CS-4392 (Cobalt throttling): add repro steps to ticket; schedule infra triage 10:30 — owner Derek H
- CS-4217 (DriftNet KV cache): confirm post-hotfix monitoring window; ask Eng for 24h extended monitoring
- CS-4470 (Skyway embeddings accuracy concern): assign to ML Ops for eval harness
- CS-4512 (Solstice KMS keys rotation question): attach compliance snippet + link to KMS runbook

QBR deck skeleton (7 slides max)
1) Title + attendee list + 1-line outcome we want (decide renewal posture + 1 pilot ask)
2) Business summary (1 slide — ARR, usage trend, top routes)
3) Reliability summary (incidents, mitigations, SLOs)
4) Cost & efficiency (per-token cost, infra contributions, Optimize suggestions)
5) Roadmap & upcoming platform changes (affects their stack)
6) Renewal & asks (pricing options, Dedicated pilot, support credits)
7) Next steps & owners

Key bullets for talking (use plain language)
- "You're driving growth; we want to keep pace without surprises — propose 3 levers: dedicated bursts, batching config, and repo-level caching."
- "We saw the incident, here's how we fixed and what we're adding to prevent recurrence."
- "If you commit to a pilot, we can model the cost impact and aim for a 15-25% token-cost reduction on peak windows."

Pre-read items to attach
- 1-pager QBR summary (1 slide exported PDF)
- Incident timeline for CS-4217 (timeline + current status)
- Cost snapshot CSV (last 90 days)

Questions to resolve (parking lot)
- Who will own pilot success metrics? (ops or product?) — ask during planning sync
- Do we offer a standard pilot contract or need SOW? (legal consult)
- Can we surface model-variant fallback during incidents automatically? (eng feasibility)

Notes to self / style reminders
- Keep slides visual: 3 bullets max, 1 chart per slide
- Use customer language ("latency impact on checkout") not infra terms
- Send pre-read at least 48h before exec slot if possible

End-of-sprint outcomes (what to post to ticketing / triage)
- Post QBR deck draft to Confluence + attach cost CSV
- Update CS-4392 and CS-4217 with final owner actions and ETA
- Book follow-up 30m on pilot scope with Derek + Eng PM + PO

Timestamped log (live updates)
- 09:05 — started export for usage (running query; ~2m)
- 09:20 — pulled cost snapshot, found anomaly in route /embed-primary
- 09:35 — drafted incident blurb for CS-4217; sent to Derek for accuracy check
- 10:08 — scheduled pilot planning 11:15 with Derek + Eng PM (tentative)

Random quick wins to try today
- Suggest lightweight caching on top-3 prompts for Cobalt (promote to infra as config change)
- Send short FAQ about what Dedicated covers (examples + costs)

--
Parking lot (non-urgent)
- Create template for "QBR pre-read" (one-pager) to reuse across accounts
- Build mini-checklist script to extract p95/p50/p99 automatically for slides

End of note.

(we'll iterate on wording for exec slide after Eng confirms incident blurb)
